component.name: Fedi3
component.summary: Self-hosted ActivityPub client with P2P sync, chat and calls

description.p: Fedi3 is a self-hosted ActivityPub client. Your account, profile and posts live in a local Rust core on the device, while a relay you control carries federation traffic when the app is offline.

ul.li: Your identity and data stay on your device; the relay stores only sealed chat envelopes and forwards ActivityPub traffic.
Multi-device sync over P2P, with QR pairing to link a new phone or PC and transfer the account, profile and chat history.
Chat with direct and group threads, voice and video notes, and calls with screen sharing.
Push-only background notifications and optional self-hosted push gateway (Web Push or ntfy) per relay.
Full ActivityPub timelines, profiles, follow requests and moderation tools.
No proprietary tracking, no Google Play Services required.
